summary: CR-385 v2.18 delta testing (alert priority/tags/links + booking advance+GST bill lines). All 8 areas verified passing on 1920x800 mockup. No JS console errors. Regressions (?bill=103 shows ~₹2,677, ?checkin=a2 renders unchanged) intact.

detailed_findings.alert_popover: PASS. Header 'All alerts · 6 · most urgent first'. 6 rows in priority order: Overdue (urgent, .t-overdue), Housekeeping x3 (urgent, .t-hk, 3h20m→2h10m→2h10m), Out of order (.t-ooo, non-urgent), No-show (.t-noshow, non-urgent). Each has .alert-tag with correct catLabel. Row count 3(bar)+3(more)=6.
detailed_findings.alert_link_precision: PASS. Overdue click → Departures tab, bill-expansion opens on A. Sharma Room 101 BK-2001. Housekeeping alert-item-1 click → Rooms tab, room 226 in view, popover closed. No-show alert-item-5 click → Arrivals/Late chip, Mark No-Show panel opens with header 'Mark No-Show · K. Menon · BK-3000 · STAY 2026-09-16 → 2026-09-17 EXPIRED' matching label.
detailed_findings.popover_toggle_close: PASS. Re-clicking alert-more removes popover (count 0). Outside click closes popover. Single #alertpop node (no duplicates).
detailed_findings.advance_in_bill: PASS. Initially booking-advance-paid absent. After advance-toggle + collect-now=1500 + pay-cash: booking-advance-paid line present, booking-balance = ₹810 (=2310-1500). Setting advance=0 removes booking-advance-paid.
detailed_findings.gst_company_in_bill: PASS. After B2B tick + gst-name 'Acme Pvt Ltd' + gst-number '27ABCDE1234F1Z5': booking-bill-gst shows 'Bill to (GST) Acme Pvt Ltd · 27ABCDE1234F1Z5'. Unticking B2B or blanking name removes the line.
detailed_findings.no_scroll_invariant: PASS at 1920x800 with advance filled + B2B on + GST name filled: .ci-pane-body scrollHeight=379, clientHeight=379, hasScroll=FALSE. booking-checkin-button bottom=726.73 (<=800).
detailed_findings.regressions: PASS. ?bill=103 checkout renders with ₹2,677 present. ?checkin=a2 renders check-in expansion unchanged. No JS console errors observed.
